materialized_acceptance.text: AC198-1: Resolve MT-197 to the existing canonical renderer/toolkit owner, supported backend/API and exact immutable dependency/proof contract. Reuse adequate existing capability without a new renderer asset/framework, duplicate implementation or mandatory source build.

AC198-2: Only if a verified reusable gap exists, bind exact canonical repository/module/path, maintenance contract, source files and author before writes. Implement/prove standalone under owning authority, publish normally and independently reread immutable source before MT-199 host adoption. No Handshake-first fork or host-private copy.

AC198-3: Preserve the capability-owned surface/window lifecycle, Vulkan selection, input/DPI/IME/accessibility and diagnostic contracts. Record unsupported behavior honestly. Host account/storage/privacy policy stays in Handshake; D3D/OpenGL fallback cannot count as Vulkan.

AC198-4: Provide exact source/dependency/API/proof/rollback identity for MT-199. Unknown owner/API/path stays UNKNOWN_PENDING_DESIGN; this conditional source stage creates no compulsory busywork or attempt grant.

AC198-5: Any verified reusable renderer/GPU capability gap must consume/extend the actual canonical centralized owner contract and focused typed clients. Standalone proof binds memory/accountability/lifecycle obligations; no per-module independent GPU device/pool/budget bypass, assumed single adapter/API, unrelated CPU/NPU move or new monolith. Reuse adequate existing capability without mandatory source work.

AC198-6: Any reusable source change preserves host-neutral typed diagnostic/failure contracts consumable by existing internal_diagnostics/Palmistry adapters. Reuse canonical watcher/source proof and do not embed a copied watcher/controller/restart mechanism inside renderer or GUI source.

AC198-7: Every row of standalone_source_gaps_20261125 is either closed by a published, independently re-read asset revision that meets its required text, or stays OPEN with the asset owner as next actor. The host implements none of them.
AC198-8: The six adoption conditions in MT-197 renderer_decision.ui_layer hold at the pinned revision before any host crate depends on it, and each has a named observed result.
AC198-9: No asset feature or adapter is removed for this work; egui adapters stay in their asset until their last consumer is gone and are retired by the asset owner afterwards.

rows.gap: UI pass and presenter create their own instance and device and settle synchronously
rows.required: UI pass records into a host-supplied image on an injected MT-203 device lease with the host's fence/timeline settlement; no own instance, device, queue, allocator or swapchain in product use; typed device-loss and rebind; the read_pane staging-after-timeout defect fixed and proven

The 2026-11-13 handoff also records read_pane freeing staging after a fence timeout at 88b5500c and 198f6dc4; not re-read at the current tip.

rows.gap: No paragraph, caret, hit test, selection, IME composition state or font fallback
rows.required: One text port: shaped paragraph with line breaks and bidi, caret stops, hit test, selection geometry, grapheme editing, composition state with cursor range, and a fallback chain covering CJK, Arabic, Hebrew and emoji with a diagnosed missing glyph; virtualised rows for 100,000 lines; AccessKit text runs. MT-216 and MT-217 consume one composition event type from here.
rows.evidence: TextPort shapes one line and rasterises one glyph (src/text.rs). The lane record lists: one family, no fallback chain, script fixed to Latn. The crate DESCRIPTOR lists IME composition, gesture arbiter, docking behaviour, AccessKit adapter and Vulkan pass as not_yet. The egui host bundles Inter plus Noto CJK, symbols, Hebrew, Arabic and Devanagari faces (app.rs install_fonts, 37828); the replacement needs at least that coverage.

rows.gap: Author-id grammar hard-coded; a duplicate stable_id mapping refuses colliding ids

rows.evidence: kumihimo-ui hard-codes STU-MDL-100/103 in src/semantic.rs valid_author_id and enforces it in src/tree.rs:440. Recon counted 497 of 741 host author-id constants failing it; a rescan at 71cc3b6d of const names containing AUTHOR under handshake_native/src finds 579 of 850 failing. The count depends on the extraction rule (prefix constants included); the majority fails either way.

standalone_source_gaps_20261125.asset_owner_request_text: To the asset dev leader (Chat thread). Handshake GUI is moving to direct Vulkan without egui (D1, D7, D8). Please provide, in order: (1) verdict and Kumihimo publication of kumihimo-ui, its text adapter and the Vulkan UI pass (KG-01); (2) UI pass on an injected MT-203 device lease with async settlement, no own instance/device/swapchain, and the read_pane timeout defect fixed (KG-02); (3) one text port: paragraph, bidi, caret, hit test, selection, IME composition, CJK/RTL/emoji fallback, virtual rows (KG-03); (4) host-supplied author-id policy (KG-04) and theme, metrics, icons, motion (KG-05); (5) roles and text runs for accessibility (KG-06); docking, tabs, pop-outs and presenters over kumihimo-core (KG-07); (6) Cabinet view adapter (KG-09), gutter, embed views, text mechanics, context menu (KG-10), port crate without wgpu (KG-11); (7) widget coverage (KG-08). Keep every existing feature and adapter. Six conditions: verdict, publication, device injection, id policy, tokens, text port. Reply with revision, API and proof per row.
